CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dc_o2o_people" (
  "id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now(),
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT now(),
  "created_by" text,
  "_revision" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "_changed_by_kind" varchar(16),
  "_changed_by_id" text,
  "_changed_by_principal_kind" varchar(64),
  "_changed_at" timestamp,
"name" text
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_dc_o2o_people_created_at" ON "dc_o2o_people"("created_at" DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_dc_o2o_people_created_by" ON "dc_o2o_people"("created_by");
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_dc_o2o_people_slug" ON "dc_o2o_people"("slug");

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dc_o2o_profiles" (
  "id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now(),
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT now(),
  "created_by" text,
  "_revision" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "_changed_by_kind" varchar(16),
  "_changed_by_id" text,
  "_changed_by_principal_kind" varchar(64),
  "_changed_at" timestamp,
"title" text,
"person" text  UNIQUE,
  CONSTRAINT "fk_dc_o2o_profiles_person" FOREIGN KEY ("person") REFERENCES "dc_o2o_people"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_dc_o2o_profiles_person" ON "dc_o2o_profiles" ("person");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_dc_o2o_profiles_created_at" ON "dc_o2o_profiles"("created_at" DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_dc_o2o_profiles_created_by" ON "dc_o2o_profiles"("created_by");
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_dc_o2o_profiles_slug" ON "dc_o2o_profiles"("slug");
